samples.claim: pub(super) merge unions Struct children in existing Self order, recursively merging same-name children and appending new Other children. List and LargeList recurse into first children. FixedSizeList with equal size succeeds without comparing element types; equal-width FixedSizeBinary succeeds. Other pairs require exact Arrow type equality, so Map has no recursive union here. No root-name check or parent metadata merge occurs. Earlier mutations are not rolled back if a later child produces a schema error.
samples.review_note: Matches Struct/List recursion, same-size fixed-list early success, exact other-type match and partial mutation on error.

samples.claim: Public track_caller get_caller_location()->&'static std::panic::Location<'static> returns Location::caller(). Public CloneableError(pub Error) has documentation specifying selective category/accessor preservation while degrading non-cloneable sources to strings. It is not a general lossless error clone. External is deliberately not preserved because a fake reconstructed source would make external_source misleading.
samples.evidence:
1053 | #[track_caller]
1054 | pub fn get_caller_location() -> &'static std::panic::Location<'static> {
1055 |     std::panic::Location::caller()
1056 | }
1057 | 
1058 | /// Wrap an error in a new error type that implements Clone
1059 | ///
1060 | /// This is useful when two threads/streams share a common fallible source
1061 | /// The variants whose meaning callers read through an accessor rather than
1062 | /// through the message survive the clone: definite not-found errors keep typed
1063 | /// source-chain detection (`is_not_found`), fenced errors keep their
1064 | /// [`FenceReason`] (`fence_reason`), backpressure stays backpressure
1065 | /// (`is_backpressure`), and an unknown commit outcome keeps its version
1066 | /// (`is_commit_status_unknown`) with the typed source degraded to its message.
1067 | /// Timeout and I/O errors preserve their categories. Everything else becomes
1068 | /// `Error::Cloned` carrying the string representation.
1069 | ///
1070 | /// One gap: [`Error::External`] is not preserved, because its source is not
1071 | /// cloneable and rebuilding it from a message would leave `external_source`
1072 | /// returning `Some` while the downcast the caller wants fails. After a clone,
1073 | /// `external_source` and `into_external` no longer recover the original error.
1074 | pub struct CloneableError(pub Error);
1075 |
samples.review_note: Matches track_caller function and selective clone documentation including External loss.

samples.claim: x86_64 selection priority is AVX512F (then FP16 bit distinguishes Avx512FP16/Avx512), AVX2 AND FMA -> Avx2, AVX AND FMA -> AvxFma, AVX -> Avx, else None. FMA gating is explicit because kernels may execute FMA even with AVX2 host support. The last fallback does not select Sse. Feature checks are cached by this LazyLock independently of simd_info's fresh vector construction.
samples.review_note: Matches priority chain; reread outer LazyLock/cfg and AVX512F/FP16 helper plus fresh diagnostic construction.

samples.claim: int_hash_of builds a fresh default IntHasher.
